decisions.reason: As a multi-variant devore line close to the established offer, it continues to have a place in the collection.
The transparent burnout line with several models remains relevant to the design-led portfolio.
As a single burnout decorative fabric overlapping with the A and B lines, it is redundant and less likely to be sustained.
Velour-like upholstery is a classic, steady product that supports the firm's upholstery range.
Flame-retardant inbetween fabric meets important functional and safety requirements for contract use.
Polyester lining with satin sheen serves a basic complementary need within the made-to-measure offer.
